full_name: Ladee Hubbard | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Ladee Hubbard is the author of two novels, The Talented Ribkins (Melville House, 2017), which received the Hurston/Wright Legacy Award and the Ernest J. Gaines Award for Literary Excellence, and The Rib King (Amistad, 2021).
